contributions.detail: Rows 1-5 (all candidate self-funding) sum to 112.50+63.97+48.29+748.00+676.91 = 1,649.67 = cover LINE 1, which reads the same 1,649.67 in BOTH the THIS-REPORT and CUMULATIVE columns -- this is the FIRST report of the cycle (the LAST-REPORT column is written 'N/A' with a long arrow drawn down through all four lines), so the two scopes COINCIDE; recorded as cumulative per the addendum. expenditures.detail: p3 rows 112.50+63.97+48.29+773,00+676.91 = 1,674.67 = cover line 3, identical in the THIS-REPORT and CUMULATIVE columns (first report of the cycle, scopes coincide). gates.balance_chain: Cover: contributions 1,649.67 + 25.00 = 1,674.67 in, expenses 1,674.67 out, line-4 balance '-0-' -- CLOSES EXACTLY. CROSS-FILING CHAIN (same filer, same cycle, both filings in this chunk): this 10/27/18 interim is the FIRST report (LAST column 'N/A'); its CUMULATIVE column (1,649.67 / 25.00 / 1,674.67 / -0-) equals line for line the TOTALS FROM LAST REPORT column of the 11/29/2018 summary (key c0e4a821). Chains exactly; no swapped-cover pair. The 748.00-on-Form-A vs 773.00-on-Form-B asymmetry for 5/11/18 appears IDENTICALLY in both filings, confirming it is the filer's own record.
